representation.name: Query 1000G chr10:110918899 genotypes
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
URL='https://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/data_collections/1000G_2504_high_coverage/working/20220422_3202_phased_SNV_INDEL_SV/1kGP_high_coverage_Illumina.chr10.filtered.SNV_INDEL_SV_phased_panel.vcf.gz'
REGION='chr10:110918899-110918899'
SAMPLES='HG01248,NA19204,NA18614,NA21123,NA19171,HG02303,HG01274,HG03134,NA18639,HG01383'
: "$(inputs.dummy.path)"
{
  echo "source_url\t${URL}"
  echo "region\t${REGION}"
  echo "samples_requested\t${SAMPLES}"
  bcftools --version | sed -n '1,2p'
} > diagnostics.txt
bcftools query --regions "$REGION" --include 'POS=110918899' --samples "$SAMPLES" --format '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT[\t%SAMPLE=%GT]\n' "$URL" > variant.tsv
records=$(wc -l < variant.tsv | tr -d ' ')
echo "records_at_exact_pos\t${records}" >> diagnostics.txt
test "$records" -eq 1
bcftools query --regions "$REGION" --include 'POS=110918899' --samples "$SAMPLES" --format '[%SAMPLE\t%GT\n]' "$URL" > sample_gt.tsv
rows=$(wc -l < sample_gt.tsv | tr -d ' ')
echo "sample_gt_rows\t${rows}" >> diagnostics.txt
test "$rows" -eq 10
cut -f2 sample_gt.tsv | sed 's@|@/@g' | paste -sd, - > answer.txt
